name: Dee Jay!
tagline: Digs out overlooked UK dance records and tidies the library behind them
description: Two jobs in one. It hunts out lesser-known techno, hardcore and jungle releases from the British scene and queues them on YouTube, and it cleans up whatever library it touches: filenames normalised, tags filled in, artwork attached. Built for collectors and uploaders whose rip folder has drifted.
author: CarlosSalas
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
